lines.zh: 斧头扛在左肩，走起来稳
lines.en: The axe on my left shoulder balances my walk.
I know every corridor of this mansion.
A wooden door ahead, good practice.
My boot soles have worn through three layers.
The column heads for the village, do not fall behind.

lines.zh: 铁斧的重量，我用了十年
lines.en: Ten years taught me the weight of this axe.
Walk along the wall, leave no footprints.
Those villager lanterns are still burning.

lines.zh: 我一步一步量过这块地
lines.en: I have measured this ground step by step.
The guard changed at the gate.
Move faster, we must arrive before dark.
My axe edge wants sharpening.

lines.zh: 磨斧子的声音，比说话舒服
lines.en: The sound of sharpening suits me better than talk.

lines.zh: 我数了数，屋里还有七扇门
lines.en: I counted seven doors left in this house.

lines.zh: 铁斧上这道缺口是上次留下的
lines.en: This notch in my axe is from last time.

lines.zh: 这处宅子太大，安静得空
lines.en: This mansion is too big and too quiet.
I am waiting for one order.
They hung the banner crooked.
My axe never leaves my hand.

lines.zh: 有人擦过这把斧头，不是我
lines.en: Someone cleaned this axe, and it was not me.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头的画，看着眼熟
lines.en: That painting at the hall's end looks familiar.
The wood smells newly cut today.
Stand there and do not move, let me look.
Your boots carry village dirt.

lines.zh: 我这把斧头今天还没动过
lines.en: This axe of mine has not swung today.
You are not from here.

lines.zh: 眼神躲什么，我又不吃人
lines.en: Why avoid my eyes, I do not eat people.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁傀儡的锈味
lines.en: You smell of rust from an iron golem.
I have your face locked in my memory.
Standing at the door, do you want in?
Keep your hand away from your back.
I count to three, then you leave.
That one goes on your account.
My pauldron is dented.
The axe nearly left my grip.
You actually landed a hit.
Blood runs down the axe handle.
I do not shout, but it still hurts.
One of my ribs made a sound.
You may be proud of that one.
I will return it doubled.

lines.zh: 站直了，这点伤不算什么
lines.en: Stand straight, this wound is nothing.
Emeralds cannot buy me.
Put the gold back where it was.
I do not trade, I only work.
Waving coins before my eyes is foolish.

lines.zh: 我的价码不在你口袋里
lines.en: My price is not in your pocket.
That piece of iron, I would take.
Do not coax me with food.
Put it down, then walk away.

lines.zh: 收买我的东西你给不起
lines.en: You cannot afford what would buy me.
I follow orders, not coins.
Bumping into me takes some nerve.
My pauldron did not need that.
Move aside, the axe has no eyes.
You stepped on my shadow.
This corridor fits only one at a time.
Try bumping me one more time.

lines.zh: 我的靴子很重，你的脚呢
lines.en: My boots are heavy, how are your feet?
Do not stand so close, I am not used to it.
Get against the wall and stay there.

lines.zh: 你挡的正好是我要劈的门
lines.en: You are blocking the very door I came to split.
Illagers do not speak of such things.
My only companion is the axe.
The warband has no such custom.
I leave no heirs, only a tally of kills.
Do not ask me questions like that.
There are no children in this mansion.
My blood spills only on the battlefield.
Companions? They vanish when the banner falls.
I take no part in such matters.
Go ask the evoker instead.
A dropped axe belongs to whoever picks it up.
This iron is mine now.
Something on the ground, mine first.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，是因为它没用
lines.en: I pick it up because it is useless.

lines.zh: 一枚绿宝石，换不了我的命
lines.en: One emerald cannot buy my life.
That arrowhead is not from my bow.
I do not care who dropped it.
I pick this up, then I go.
I recognize that banner on the ground.
My pocket holds only a whetstone.
Footsteps, from that direction.
I see you, stop hiding.
The target is behind the door.
There is a living one here.
Now, grip the axe handle tight.
Something breathes behind that door.
My eyes have locked onto you.
You will not outrun one street.
Found one, enough to keep me busy.
A figure on the rooftop.
I heard you crack a roof tile.
Target confirmed, closing in now.
You lit that lantern, did you not?
This time the evoker need not speak.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把就是标记
lines.en: The torch in your hand marks you for me
Back into the corner, I finish this once.
Your hands are shaking, good.
One step at a time, I am in no hurry.
The door cannot stop me, and neither can you.
My axe is raised.
Did you hear that sound?
Do not count on a golem to save you.
I am blocking the only exit.
Your armor has gaps in it.
This distance is one step for me.
I am watching your throat.
You may run, I will follow.
My patience lasts three swings.
Let us settle this now.
Your footsteps on the cobbles are uneven
You guard the door; I come through the window
A woodpile hides nobody
I stop two steps away
This axe swing means your luck ran out.
This is how doors get split.

lines.zh: 铁斧落下，不会问第二遍
lines.en: The axe falls and never asks twice.
Brace yourself, this one lands heavy.
My axe knows your shield by now.
Raise the axe, strike, then done.
This plank took the blow for you.
Your armor saved you once.
Again, I still have strength.
This one is for the captain.
I never hesitate when splitting things.
You stepped back twice, good.
The edge chipped, I keep swinging.
Stay down and save your strength.
My second swing aims at your shield rim
You dodge sideways; the axe follows
The mansion door opens, I step out.
The banner unfurls, the warband gathers.
I was posted to guard this floor.

lines.zh: 从黑暗里走出来，握紧斧头
lines.en: Out of the dark, axe in hand.
I lead the front of this raid.
Someone sounded the horn.
I woke at the end of the corridor.
When the door opened, I was behind it.
The captain called my name.
I report for duty with my axe.
The mansion needs more guards.
We reach the village gate before dawn.
Fire, keep away from my axe.
Falling from this floor was a waste.
Water is harder to fight than blades.
My ears are ringing.
Arrows from behind, coward's work.

lines.zh: 紫色的光，唤魔者的把戏
lines.en: Purple light, an evoker's trick.
Hungry, I can still split a door.
Only thunder, keep going.
The ground is gone below, I do not care.
